title: Conditions for Billing a Visit to the Payer — Insured Plan of Care
content:
**Billing desk reference — Insured Plan of Care.** A visit is billed to the payer under a plan of care only when every condition below that applies to the plan's payer program holds.

## Conditions

1. **Plan status.** A visit is billed against the plan only while the plan is in intake or active status. The initial evaluation is billed in intake; every other visit requires active status.
2. **Authorization.** Where the payer program requires prior authorization, a visit after the first exempt visits is billed only when an approved authorization covers the visit date and still has visits remaining. The visit then records that authorization number and draws one authorized visit; an evaluation draws one authorized visit only where the payer program's evaluation draws an authorized visit. Where the payer program requires no prior authorization, the visit records no authorization number and draws no authorized visit.
3. **Certification period.** Where physician certification is required, no visit dated after the certification end date is billed until the plan is recertified.
4. **Weekly frequency.** Visits on one plan may not exceed the payer program's weekly visit maximum in a Monday-to-Sunday week.
5. **Timed units.** Timed units are counted by the payer program's unit-counting method and capped at its maximum timed units per visit.
6. **Telehealth.** A telehealth treatment visit is billed only where the payer program covers telehealth.
7. **Timely filing.** A claim not filed within the payer program's timely filing period, in calendar days after the visit date, is written off and is never billed to the patient.

**Evidence.** The plan's status and its authorizations — authorization number, the first and last dates of service each covers, and the authorized visits remaining on the plan — are read from the plan's system records. An authorization is matched to a visit by its number and by its date span covering the visit date.

## Status check at a glance

| Plan status | Initial evaluation | Any other visit |
|---|---|---|
| Intake | Billed | Not billed |
| Active | Billed | Billed, subject to conditions 2 to 7 |
| On hold, discharged or closed | Not billed | Not billed |

## Authorization check — hypothetical cases on a payer program requiring authorization with 1 exempt visit

- The initial evaluation is the first visit and falls within the exempt visit; it needs no approved authorization to be billed.
- A treatment visit dated 2026-04-14 under an approval covering 2026-04-01 to 2026-04-30 with 3 authorized visits remaining is billed, records that authorization number and draws one authorized visit, leaving 2.
- The same visit with 0 authorized visits remaining, or dated 2026-05-02 after the approval's last covered date, is not billed against the plan.

## Weekly frequency — hypothetical case

With a weekly maximum of 3, visits on Monday, Wednesday and Friday of one week fill that week; a fourth visit on the Saturday of the same Monday-to-Sunday week exceeds it, while a visit on the following Monday starts a new week.
